changeHypothesis.summary: PV upstream prices reversed sharply lower while leading downstream inverter/storage companies already had strong Q3 earnings. 德业 had the strongest profit/cash acceleration and was deeply de-rated, but 锦浪/阳光 also had strong engines and comparable/lower forward valuation, so no clear cross-sectional asymmetry exists.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: New upstream capacity and demand economics can support lower system cost across multiple quarters.
disconfirmingEvidence: All three PV candidates are heavily de-rated, suggesting sector-level risk may be broader than input costs.
德业 2023E PE ~35x is not obviously cheaper than 锦浪/阳光.
European household storage demand/FX could normalize.
